column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a control that is not one of the six is malformed
a row for alternate given the verdict it may not have is malformed
a row for decoupled_satisfaction given the verdict it may not have is malformed
a row for decoupled_violation given the verdict it may not have is malformed
a row for irrelevant given the verdict it may not have is malformed
a row for restoration given the verdict it may not have is malformed
a row for violation given the verdict it may not have is malformed
a table whose every row is malformed refuses --gate
a violation row expecting pass over a no-op mutation is never run, so never met
a violation row expecting pass refuses --gate rather than counting as met
and --gate names the row and the verdict its control demands
and names the rows it could not read
and names under it a checker short of the six controls, without refusing
and shows the row and the verdict under qualified FAIL
and so does commenting a control out
and so does flipping the verdict a control expects
and so does swapping its mutation for one that changes nothing
and the report says which verdict the control demands
deleting a control from it escapes as verifier
felix gate fails qualification over a row whose verdict is not its control's
